dict.string: MacMint looks for similar and blurry photos in your library. Photos are analysed on this Mac and are only removed when you confirm in Photos.
MacMint inspects Desktop files when you scan this location for storage, duplicates or photos. Changes require your review.
MacMint inspects Documents when you scan this location for storage, duplicates, photos or developer files. Changes require your review.
MacMint measures Downloads and helps you review files to keep or move to Trash. Nothing is removed without your confirmation.
MacMint reads selected network locations to map storage. Removal from external locations is not supported.
MacMint reads selected removable drives to map storage. Removal from external locations is not supported.
MacMint inspects app containers to measure storage and identify related data for your review. Removal requires your confirmation.
MacMint inspects installed apps and moves selected apps to Trash only after you confirm an uninstall.
